top_band: grey-blue tiled roof slope (rows 1-14) above wooden pillars and stone water basin (top rim rows 29-35, front face rows 36-42)
evidence: The structure clearly shows a 14-row sloped tile roof seen from above (rows 1-14) with an eave shadow (rows 15-16), wooden pillars on the sides (rows 17-43), and a stone water basin at the bottom showing both its top rim/water opening (rows 29-35) and vertical front face (rows 36-42).

style.evidence: While the roof has a 5-step ramp and tile texture, the lower half of the sprite has large flat fills with no texture or grain: the stone basin front face (rows 37-42, 16x6 px solid grey block), the wooden pillars (2-colour vertical bands without wood grain), and the water surface. Heavy near-black outlines surround the pillars and basin, making it look much flatter than the richly textured Beodeul well and stall references.
